notice: Entirely synthetic. No real PHI. Structured facts are the ground truth; documents are rendered from them by backend/scripts/seed_data.py.

profiles.rich: Multiple documents; problem list, medications, allergies and encounter notes.
profiles.conflicting: Documents disagree with each other (tests contradiction handling).

patients.name: Jane, Anne
patients.edge_case: Temporal trap: pregnancy in 2021 is RESOLVED. Prior MI, penicillin allergy.

encounters.title: ER note: third-trimester pregnancy, reduced fetal movement
encounters.text: 33 weeks pregnant, reduced fetal movement. Reassuring CTG, discharged to obstetrics follow-up. Delivered healthy infant Feb 2021. Condition RESOLVED.

encounters.title: Discharge summary: NSTEMI
encounters.text: Presented with crushing substernal chest pain and diaphoresis. Troponin elevated. Cath: 90% proximal LAD stenosis, drug-eluting stent placed. Discharged on aspirin, atorvastatin.

encounters.title: Discharge summary: hypertensive urgency
encounters.text: BP 212/118 with headache, no end-organ damage. Lisinopril increased to 20 mg. Counselled on adherence.

encounters.title: Lab summary: diabetes and lipid panel
encounters.text: HbA1c 7.9% (target <7). LDL 92 mg/dL. eGFR 78. Potassium 4.4.

encounters.title: ER note: breakthrough seizure
encounters.text: Generalised seizure after two missed levetiracetam doses. Post-ictal 40 minutes, returned to baseline. CT head negative.

encounters.title: Neurology clinic note
encounters.text: Seizure-free since September. Adherence reinforced. No driving for 6 months from last seizure.

encounters.title: Discharge summary: COPD exacerbation
encounters.text: Admitted 4 days with COPD exacerbation, treated with steroids and nebulisers. Baseline SpO2 92-93% on room air at discharge.

encounters.title: Pulmonary function tests
encounters.text: FEV1 41% predicted, FEV1/FVC 0.52. Severe obstruction, stable versus 2025.

encounters.title: ER note: right lower quadrant pain
encounters.text: RLQ pain. Ultrasound: 4 cm simple right ovarian cyst, no torsion. Appendix normal. Follow-up ultrasound Sept 2023 showed resolution.

patients.name: Patel, Priya
patients.edge_case: Prior DVT; anticoagulant DISCONTINUED (temporal trap for the anticoagulation rule).

encounters.title: ER note: left leg DVT
encounters.text: Unilateral left calf swelling. Doppler: femoral-popliteal DVT. Started apixaban, oral contraceptive stopped.

encounters.title: Hematology clinic note
encounters.text: Completed 6 months apixaban; stopped. Heterozygous factor V Leiden. Advised avoiding estrogen-containing contraception.

encounters.title: ER note: epigastric pain after meals
encounters.text: Postprandial RUQ/epigastric pain. Ultrasound: multiple gallstones, no cholecystitis. Referred for elective cholecystectomy (not yet scheduled).

encounters.title: Discharge summary: obstructing ureteral stone
encounters.text: 7 mm left ureteral stone with hydronephrosis. Ureteroscopy and laser lithotripsy. Stone analysis: calcium oxalate.

encounters.title: CT KUB
encounters.text: Two non-obstructing 3 mm right renal stones. No hydronephrosis.

encounters.title: Immunization record
encounters.text: Tdap booster given 2019-08-22. Next tetanus booster due 2029.

encounters.title: Primary care annual visit
encounters.text: Asthma well controlled, albuterol use under twice monthly. Latex allergy noted for procedures.

encounters.title: ER note: right ankle inversion injury
encounters.text: Inversion injury playing football. Ottawa rules negative, no X-ray. RICE, crutches. Recovered by August 2023.

encounters.title: Primary care physical
encounters.text: Healthy. No chronic conditions. Exercises regularly.

encounters.title: Lab summary
encounters.text: TSH 2.1 (normal). Creatinine 0.9. BP at clinic 132/80.

encounters.title: Primary care follow-up
encounters.text: Stable on current regimen. 90-day refills issued for amlodipine, levothyroxine, alendronate.

patients.name: Ibrahim, Yusuf
patients.edge_case: Contradiction: allergy record documents penicillin anaphylaxis; a later urgent-care note records 'no known drug allergies'.

encounters.title: ER note: anaphylaxis after amoxicillin
encounters.text: Throat tightness, urticaria and hypotension 20 minutes after first amoxicillin dose for strep throat. IM epinephrine given. Penicillin allergy documented.

encounters.title: Urgent care note: sore throat
encounters.text: Sore throat 3 days. Patient states no known drug allergies. Rapid strep positive. Prescribed azithromycin.

encounters.title: Anticoagulation clinic
encounters.text: INR 2.6. eGFR 52. Warfarin dose unchanged.

encounters.title: Discharge summary: AF with rapid ventricular response
encounters.text: AF with RVR 150s, rate controlled with metoprolol. Continued warfarin.

encounters.title: Discharge summary: aortic valve replacement
encounters.text: Mechanical AVR for severe aortic stenosis (bicuspid valve). Lifelong warfarin.

encounters.title: Anticoagulation clinic
encounters.text: INR 3.1, within target.

patients.name: Chang, Wei
patients.edge_case: Atrial fibrillation NOT anticoagulated (declined) plus prior TIA: high stroke risk.

encounters.title: Discharge summary: TIA
encounters.text: 20 minutes of right arm weakness, fully resolved. MRI no infarct. CHA2DS2-VASc 3. Anticoagulation offered and declined by patient; aspirin started.

patients.name: Mwangi, Grace
patients.edge_case: Severe asthma with prior ICU intubation; aspirin-exacerbated respiratory disease.

encounters.title: Discharge summary: status asthmaticus, ICU
encounters.text: Near-fatal asthma, intubated 2 days in ICU. Trigger: viral URI. High-risk asthma flag added.

encounters.title: Pulmonology clinic note
encounters.text: Two ER visits this year. Adherence fair. Biologic therapy being considered.

encounters.title: Discharge summary: DKA
encounters.text: DKA (pH 7.12) triggered by insulin pump failure. Resolved with insulin infusion. Switched to injections.

encounters.title: Lab summary
encounters.text: HbA1c 7.2%. Monofilament sensation reduced in both feet (early neuropathy).

patients.edge_case: Asplenia after trauma: high risk for overwhelming infection.

encounters.title: Immunization record

encounters.title: ER note: migraine with vomiting
encounters.text: Typical migraine with visual aura and vomiting. Neuro exam normal. IV fluids, metoclopramide. Discharged.

encounters.title: MRI brain
encounters.text: No intracranial abnormality.

encounters.title: ER note: hand laceration
encounters.text: 2 cm laceration to left palm, sutured. Tetanus toxoid given.

encounters.title: 2-month well-child visit

encounters.title: Pulmonary function tests

patients.name: Lindqvist, Erik
patients.edge_case: Hypertension plus dilated ascending aorta: dissection presentation with normal vitals.

medications.name: Losartan

encounters.title: Cardiology note

encounters.title: Annual physical
encounters.text: Healthy. Plays recreational basketball. Prior left wrist sprain 2018, fully recovered.

encounters.title: School immunization record

encounters.text: Persistent dry cough for 3 months, likely ACE-inhibitor related. Lisinopril STOPPED; losartan 50 mg started. Medication list not yet updated.
